subject: DPIA: Art.30 ledger extract + subprocessor evidence request (MediCore)
body:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medicorehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medicorehealth.com, dpo@medicorehealth.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: DPIA evidence request — Art.30 ledger + subprocessors

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As part of MediCore's DPIA we need a concise extract of Redwood's Article 30 processing activities relevant to the MediCore integration plus the current list of subprocessors and any associated transfer mechanisms. Specifically we need: 

- A CSV export of Art.30 entries for processing activities that could touch MediCore data (columns: activity_id, description, legal_basis, categories_of_data, recipients, retention_period, transfers)
- The latest signed subprocessor list and the date of last update
- Documentation or evidence of the legal basis for transfers outside the EEA (SCCs / adequacy / UK addendum)
- Any recent DPIA / assessment notes that reference caching, KV stores, or telemetry retention (high level is fine).

Deadline: can you provide this by end-of-day Friday 2027-09-03? MediCore's DPO wants to validate our risk register on Monday. If there are items that cannot be shared due to sensitivity, please flag and we can route via an NDA or a redacted packet.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Legal Operations
MediCore Health

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 10:23:40 +0000
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence request — Art.30 ledger + subprocessors

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can deliver the Art.30 extract and the subprocessor packet; karthik will prepare a CSV export and a PDF of the active subprocessors with dates and transfer mechanisms.

Quick clarifications: 
- Is the scope limited to processing that originates from EU customers only, or do you want all processing activities where MediCore data *could* be processed globally? (We can filter by customer-region tags.)
- For transfer evidence: SCCs are in-place for our EU business; if you need the signed SCC document we usually route that via our legal team and DocuSign.

Proposed timeline: 
- Thu 2027-09-02: preliminary Art.30 CSV + subprocessor list (redacted if needed)
- Fri 2027-09-03: follow-up with transfer mechanism artifacts (SCC summary, adequacy references) and short DPIA briefing note

If that's OK I'll have karthik attach the CSV and a short README explaining columns and filtering. Grace will coordinate any escalation to Legal if a full signed SCC is requested.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medicorehealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Sep 2027 16:05:12 +0000
Subject: Art.30 extract + subprocessors (attached)

Hi Elena / Tessa / Grace —

Attached: 
- art30_extract_20270902.csv (CSV export: activity_id,customer_tag,description,legal_basis,data_categories,recipients,retention_days,transfer_mechanism,last_review)
- subprocessors_20270902.pdf (current subprocessor roster with onboarding dates and transfer notes)

Notes: 
- The CSV has rows filtered to customer_tag contains "mediocore" and customer-region = EU where tagged; if you prefer an unfiltered export say the word and we will produce a full ledger.
- Transfer_mechanism column includes: "SCCs-in-place", "Adequacy:UK", "On-prem/No-transfer" as applicable. We redacted IP addresses and sample logs per our data minimization policy.
- For full SCCs or signed annexes we circulate via DocuSign; see a link we can generate if Legal requires executed copies.

Attachments (stubs): 
- art30_extract_20270902.csv (CSV, 14 KB)
- subprocessors_20270902.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

If you want an explanation of any specific activity row just flag the activity_id.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Privacy Engineering
Redwood Inference

---
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medicorehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Sep 2027 08:17:55 +0200
Subject: Re: Art.30 extract + subprocessors (attached)

Karthik, Tessa — thanks for the fast turnaround. I reviewed the PDF and had two quick follow-ups: 

1) Subprocessor "CloudStream Ltd" shows "SCCs-in-place / US region" — can you confirm whether MediCore data is ever routed to their US infra, and if so whether the SCCs include redress/DPD contacts?
2) The CSV row activity_id ACT-139 references "prefix caching" — can you share the retention_days and whether cached KV stores are encrypted at rest and accessible to support engineers?

If these are quick confirmations we'll close the DPIA item; otherwise MediCore's DPO has asked for a short addendum doc.

Regards,
Elena

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 Sep 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Art.30 extract + subprocessors (attached)

Elena —

Quick responses inline below.

On Sat, 3 Sep 2027 at 08:17 +0200 Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medicorehealth.com> wrote:
> 1) Subprocessor "CloudStream Ltd" shows "SCCs-in-place / US region" — can you confirm whether MediCore data is ever routed to their US infra, and if so whether the SCCs include redress/DPD contacts?

CloudStream note: We use CloudStream for queued delivery where customers opt into real-time webhooks. By default customer data for EU customers stays in EU regions; however, CloudStream's incident-processing workflow may route traces to their US operations for troubleshooting. SCCs are executed between Redwood and CloudStream (we have a signed SCC template) and include point-of-contact info; we can provide the contact details to your DPO under an NDA.

> 2) The CSV row activity_id ACT-139 references "prefix caching" — can you share the retention_days and whether cached KV stores are encrypted at rest and accessible to support engineers?

ACT-139: retention_days = 14; KV caches are encrypted at rest using customer-keyed envelopes (KMS) for Dedicated customers and our platform-managed keys for hosted. Support access is role-restricted and audited; engineers do not have broad read access without an approved escalation ticket. We can provide sample audit log excerpts (redacted) if needed.

Next steps: 
- If MediCore wants the signed SCC for CloudStream we will coordinate via Legal and can push a DocuSign packet (link available).
- If you need the audit log excerpt please send a short scope (time range and activity_ids).

Happy to hop on a quick call with your DPO on Wed 2027-09-06 if helpful.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced as stubs above.
